description: Attractor grid: grid of points, circles whose radius shrinks with distance to an attractor; needs discovery of several components.
userPrompt: Build an attractor grid: a rectangular grid of points (5 to 20 points per side, spacing 1 to 3 m) and a circle at every point whose radius shrinks with the distance to an attractor point. Inputs: grid count, spacing, attractor x and y. Rule: radius = distance remapped into 0.1 to 0.5 m. Principle: an attractor-driven perforation pattern. Evaluation: keep every radius at least 0.1 m. Build it.
